policy: Planning guidance only. A verified trait never automatically approves an answer. No rarity values or live exports.

questions.requirement: Name any character with red hair.
questions.include: Recurring red hair in the named anime adaptation.
questions.exclude: Do not infer adjacent colours, monochrome manga colours or alternate-art colours. Temporary dyes and transformed forms require a distinct decision.

questions.requirement: Name any character who wears a mask.
questions.include: A recurring worn mask clearly covers part of the face.
questions.exclude: A single disguise, face paint or non-worn equipment does not establish eligibility.

questions.requirement: Name any character who wears glasses or sunglasses.
questions.include: Recurring ordinary spectacles or sunglasses in the named anime adaptation.
questions.exclude: Temporary disguises need an explicit decision. Goggles, monocles and sports goggles are excluded by default; sports spectacles need visual/editorial review.

questions.requirement: Name any doctor, medic or healer.
questions.include: Practises medicine or demonstrates a recurring healing role/ability.
questions.exclude: A medical-looking costume, self-regeneration alone or one first-aid scene is insufficient.

questions.requirement: Name any animal companion, pet or summon.
questions.include: An actual animal companion, pet or summon with a documented relationship.
questions.exclude: Species alone does not establish companion status; mascots and humanoid partners require review.

questions.requirement: Name any character with white or silver hair.
questions.include: Recurring white, silver hair in the named anime adaptation.
questions.exclude: Do not infer adjacent colours, monochrome manga colours or alternate-art colours. Temporary dyes and transformed forms require a distinct decision.

questions.requirement: Name any character with blonde hair.
questions.include: Recurring blonde hair in the named anime adaptation.
questions.exclude: Do not infer adjacent colours, monochrome manga colours or alternate-art colours. Temporary dyes and transformed forms require a distinct decision.

questions.requirement: Name any character who fights with fire.
questions.include: Explicitly fights using fire, flames or lava; preserve the current prompt’s inclusion of flame/sun breathing.
questions.exclude: Do not infer powers from red hair, names or aura colour. Training-only or unadapted manga feats require exclusion/review.

questions.requirement: Name any character who fights with lightning or electricity.
questions.include: Explicit combat use of lightning or electricity.
questions.exclude: Speed metaphors, names and electrical-looking effects without a supported ability are insufficient.

questions.requirement: Name any teacher, sensei or mentor.
questions.include: Recurring teaching or an explicit sustained mentor relationship.
questions.exclude: Age, seniority or giving one piece of advice is insufficient.

questions.requirement: Name any character with pink hair.
questions.include: Recurring pink hair in the named anime adaptation.
questions.exclude: Do not infer adjacent colours, monochrome manga colours or alternate-art colours. Temporary dyes and transformed forms require a distinct decision.

questions.requirement: Name any character with green hair.
questions.include: Recurring green hair in the named anime adaptation.
questions.exclude: Do not infer adjacent colours, monochrome manga colours or alternate-art colours. Temporary dyes and transformed forms require a distinct decision.

questions.requirement: Name any king, queen, prince, princess or royal.
questions.include: Named hereditary or formally recognized royal position in context.
questions.exclude: Honorific nicknames and self-appointed titles are not enough.

questions.requirement: Name any twin, triplet, quadruplet or quintuplet.
questions.include: Explicit multiple-birth sibling relationship.
questions.exclude: Lookalikes, clones, alternate identities and unrelated similar characters are excluded.

questions.include: Separate title/studio/genre/episode-count source and eligibility project.
questions.exclude: Character traits cannot establish this answer.

questions.requirement: Name any anime detective.
questions.include: Recurring professional or amateur investigation is supported by direct anime evidence.
questions.exclude: Solving one mystery, a police job alone, or detective in the title is insufficient. Record employment subtype separately.

questions.requirement: Name any vampire.
questions.include: Explicit vampire identity in the adaptation.
questions.exclude: Dhampirs, vampire hunters, cosplay and temporary forms require distinct review.

questions.requirement: Name any robot, android or cyborg.
questions.include: Documented robot, android or cyborg identity.
questions.exclude: Mecha pilots, armour and prosthetics alone do not prove the classification; settle partial-body cyborg boundaries.

questions.requirement: Name any ninja who isn’t from Naruto.
questions.include: Explicit ninja role in an anime other than Naruto.
questions.exclude: Exclude Naruto roles even if another appearance exists; establish the qualifying non-Naruto adaptation.

questions.requirement: Name any character who wears an eyepatch.
questions.include: Recognizable recurring eyepatch in the specified anime period.
questions.exclude: Temporary medical bandages need a separate decision; record injuries and time period.

questions.requirement: Name any cat character.
questions.include: Actual feline identity in the adaptation. A documented cat transformation is separately reviewed with episode/form context.
questions.exclude: Cat ears, costumes, nicknames, catlike humanoids, lions, cat statues and transformed humans are not automatically eligible.

questions.requirement: Name any dragon.
questions.include: Explicit dragon identity or a documented dragon form.
questions.exclude: Dragon names, dragon slayers and draconic features alone are insufficient; forms require context.

questions.requirement: Name any Shinigami, reaper or death god.
questions.include: Documented shinigami, reaper or death-god role/identity.
questions.exclude: Death-themed powers, skull motifs and grim nicknames alone are insufficient.

questions.requirement: Name any character known for wearing a hat.
questions.include: Known for a recurring worn hat in the anime.
questions.exclude: One-off costume headgear and hair ornaments are not automatically hats.
